text_block_list.text: Walking down the hallway one day, I spotted Transcend looking around with extreme caution.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Shh, keep it down.
...I'm being targeted right now.
choice_data_list: Sounds serious... How did that happen?
Sounds serious... How did that happen?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Oh? You really wanna ask about that?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, I have a pretty good guess why.
Even if it's my own doing, it's quite a headache~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Anyway, no matter who asks or what they ask, don't tell them where I went, got it?
Leaving behind those words, Transcend headed off toward the rooftop.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, Trainer.
Seen Tran-san anywhere?

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
For real? Where'd she go, seriously...
Oh well, lemme know if you spot her!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me while you are on break.
Have you seen Tran-san?
choice_data_list: I haven't, but... do you need her for something?
I haven't, but... do you need her for something?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes. I must properly express my gratitude to her.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Furioso-san! Tran-san wasn't over that way either.
Hmm, wherever could she have gone?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Trainer-san,
would you happen to have seen Tran-san around?
choice_data_list: D-Did something happen between you all and her?
D-Did something happen between you all and her?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trouble? Oh goodness, no~
The reason we're looking for her is—
Just as expected, Transcend was up on the rooftop.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-chan?
What's up?
choice_data_list: Sorry, I told them where you were.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, seriously?
...Don't tell me, did you find out the whole story?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ohh, there she is~!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Tran-san. Today of all days—
I will convey my thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, yeah. And?

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, Tran-san, you're always helping us out,
but you never let us thank you properly, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: You always make excuses and run off right away!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: So we thought we'd make sure to give Tran-san our proper thanks, you see~

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: We decided to team up and track you down together.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh, is that so.
Sorry for making you go through all that trouble.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
(They really are good kids, all of 'em.
Makes helping them worth every second. But still—)

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Now that we found Tran-san, let's head to the cafeteria! ☆

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: We prepared a modest tea party for you, so please come join us!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, I feel bad making you go that far.
Well then, guess I'll gladly accept the treat.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's still going strong! They even prepared delicious snacks and presents for me...
They're such sweet girls, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Still, I was only doing what comes naturally, so being thanked this much makes me feel a bit bashful.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Besides, things like gratitude and thank-yous don't really suit an info broker, do they?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's suuuuch a pain, really.
Total obstruction of business, right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
What's that smirk for?
You're a weird one, Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well then, guess I should head back soon.
I am the guest of honor, after all♪
Saying that, Transcend walked away with a noticeably light and cheerful step.
